name: Growing Pains
description: Fatherhood has taken on a whole new meaning for Jason Seaver, who has assumed the chores of cooking, cleaning and minding the kids so that his wife, Maggie, can pursue a career in journalism after spending 15 years as a housewife.

videos.title: Unaired Pilot Scenes
videos.overview: Scenes from the Growing Pains original unaired pilot, which featured Elizabeth Ward as Carol Seaver, prior to the role being recast and given to Tracey Gold.

videos.title: Gag Reel
videos.overview: Gag Reel

videos.title: Seaver Family Reunion: S'mores and More
videos.overview: Created just for the Season One DVD, "Seaver Family Reunion: S'mores and More" brings together the first-season main cast with writer/producer Tim O'Donnell for a half-hour backyard campfire chat about the show, while they toast marshmallows and make s'mores.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Maggie goes back to work as a journalist, prompting psychologist Jason to move his office into their home so he can keep his eye on the kids. Things don't get off to a great start: the first night he gets a call from the police that Mike has been picked up for illegally driving a car.

videos.title: Springsteen
videos.overview: Jason embarrasses Mike at a Bruce Springsteen concert when they are interviewed together.

videos.title: Jealousy
videos.overview: Jason fumes when Maggie spends long hours on a toxic waste story with handsome co-worker Fred.

videos.title: Carol's Article
videos.overview: Maggie gives an honest assessment of Carol's writing of an article for her school magazine; Mike and Ben discover track betting.

videos.title: Superdad!
videos.overview: Maggie accuses Jason of monopolizing the children.

videos.title: Mike's Madonna Story
videos.overview: Mike's infatuation with a Madonna look-alike worries Maggie.

videos.title: Weekend Fantasy
videos.overview: Jason and Maggie want to go to a mountain lodge for a weekend, but are reluctant to leave the kids alone.

videos.title: Slice of Life
videos.overview: Coming across a compatibility test in Jason's office, Maggie decides she and Jason should fill it out, but her answers don't tab with his. Meanwhile, Mike feigns interest in karate when his real goal is a girl attending the course.

videos.title: Carol's Crush
videos.overview: Carol develops a crush on a family friend, who thinks of her as his little sister.

videos.title: Dirt Bike
videos.overview: Mike hurts more than his pride when he takes a nasty fall off a dirt bike that he promised his parents he wouldn't go near.

videos.title: Standardized Test
videos.overview: Mike doodles on his aptitude test and winds up with an IQ score of 27.

videos.title: A Christmas Story
videos.overview: A depressed department store Santa consulting Jason decides to commit suicide by leaping down the Seavers' chimney.

videos.title: The Love Song of M. Aaron Seaver
videos.overview: Mike backs out of the family-bowling match so he can date a snobbish girlfriend.

videos.title: First Blood
videos.overview: Jason faces off against Ben's hockey coach, who's teaching the boys to play dirty; Mike learns ballroom dancing.

videos.title: Slice of Life II
videos.overview: Maggie casually mentions to Jason that she might be pregnant; Mike acts as a weekend servant to Ben; and Carol wants to divorce her class-project husband.

videos.title: The Seavers vs. the Cleavers
videos.overview: The PTA head rejects the Seavers as dance chaperones.

videos.title: Charity Begins at Home
videos.overview: Ben gives Jason a very expensive birthday present, causing speculation on how he can possibly afford it.

videos.title: Reputation
videos.overview: Mike writes test answers on his shoe soles.

videos.title: The Anniversary That Never Was
videos.overview: Maggie's assignment interferes with anniversary plans.

videos.title: Be a Man
videos.overview: Custodian Mike watches a wild party explode in his home.

videos.title: Career Decision
videos.overview: Reporter Maggie and psychiatrist Jason both face important career decisions.

videos.title: Extra Lap
videos.overview: Mike's practical-joker uncle Bob visits from the hereafter.

videos.title: Jason and the Cruisers
videos.overview: Maggie plans a surprise reunion for Jason's college rock band.

videos.title: Fast Times at Dewey High
videos.overview: A new school year brings boredom, bullies, and romantic mix-ups.

videos.title: Long Day's Journey Into Night
videos.overview: A cheerleader befriends Carol solely to meet Mike.

videos.title: Call Me
videos.overview: Ben has been calling an X-rated phone service.

videos.title: Employee of the Month
videos.overview: Fired Mike hides the truth from his parents.

videos.title: Dream Lover
videos.overview: Carol spreads rumors about herself and a "hunk".

videos.title: Do You Believe in Magic?
videos.overview: A con man sells Mike a "magic" rock.

videos.title: Jason's Rib
videos.overview: A proposed school dress code puts Maggie and Jason at odds.

videos.title: The Kid
videos.overview: Ben invites a street girl home for the holidays.

videos.title: The Breakfast Club
videos.overview: Grounded liar Mike hears Maggie fibbing to her boss.

videos.title: Choices
videos.overview: Carol has the chance to skip a high-school grade.

videos.title: Higher Education
videos.overview: A girl raises a grade for Mike, then demands payment.

videos.title: Some Enchanted Evening
videos.overview: The winter formal causes opposite problems for Carol and Mike.

videos.title: Thank You, Willie Nelson
videos.overview: Maggie's quarreling parents come to visit the Seavers.

videos.title: Thank God It's Friday
videos.overview: Mike and his friends go to a college party and have to decide whether to use drugs or not.

videos.title: My Brother, Myself
videos.overview: Mike plays Cupid for smitten Ben and his baby sitter.

videos.title: Jimmy Durante Died for Your Sins

videos.title: Carnival
videos.overview: Maggie's busy schedule leaves Ben feeling neglected.

videos.title: Born Free

videos.title: The Long Goodbye
videos.overview: Maggie wants Jason to fire the elderly handyman he hired to fix the furnace, but he refuses because the man is a friend.

videos.title: Confidentially Yours
videos.overview: Jason knows the editor offering Maggie a dream job is a notorious womanizer.

videos.title: Aloha
videos.overview:
The family is stranded in Maui.

Ben videotapes Mike and Carol's Hawaiian romances.

videos.title: Taking Care of Business
videos.overview: Mike uses double talk to sell stereos.

videos.title: Not Necessarily the News
videos.overview: The family scrambles to help find an out-of-work Maggie a job after she turns into Super Mom, preparing oversize meals and assigning new chores.

videos.title: Michaelgate
videos.overview: Mike is unaware that he's been nominated for student-body president because he's "a sure loser."

videos.title: Big Brother is Not Watching
videos.overview: Ben asks Carol's advice on getting a new bike from their parents.

videos.title: A Star is Born
videos.overview: A star is born when Mike lands a leading role in the school play opposite the lovely Monica.

videos.title: Gone But Not Forgotten
videos.overview: Burglars hit the Seaver home.

videos.title: Who's Zoomin' Who?
videos.overview: Bobby's annoying habits make Carol look elsewhere for the man of her dreams -- just in time for her to notice a new student.

videos.title: This is Your Life
videos.overview: During a tonsillectomy, Ben has an out-of-body experience, dreaming that he escapes with a friendly cabbie, only to find a new Ben has replaced him at home.

videos.title: Broadway Bound
videos.overview: After their success in the school play, Mike and Monica set their sights on a Broadway audition for ""Our Town.""

videos.title: The Scarlet Letter
videos.overview: An unearned "A" makes Carol doubt her academic record.

videos.title: A Reason to Live
videos.overview: A troubled student named Jill volunteers to work on a school project with Mike and Boner. This, however, is a subterfuge: Jill has been contemplating suicide due to some very serious problems at home, and she hopes to get some free counseling from Mike's psychiatrist dad Jason. But as it turns out, Jason is presently weighed down with a few self-pity issues of his own.

videos.title: Nasty Habits
videos.overview: Maggie and Jason try to keep Mike in his room to complete an English paper, but Mike's mind is of course elsewhere.

videos.title: The Marrying Kind
videos.overview: Reason flies out the window when Bobby and his parents arrive at the Seavers' for dinner and a special announcement -- that Bobby and Carol are engaged.

videos.title: State of the Union
videos.overview: Maggie fumes over the many irritants that seem to be driving her and Jason apart -- until unexpected news sheds light on the situation.

videos.title: The Mom Who Knew Too Much
videos.overview: Maggie and Carol share confidences at the beauty salon, but later Carol learns to her chagrin that a secret isn't safe with Maggie.

videos.title: Great Expectations
videos.overview: A letter from the girl he met in Hawaii has Mike scheming to fly to Los Angeles to see her without his parents' knowing.

videos.title: Dance Fever (1)
videos.overview: At the school dance, Mike gets a girl and Carol gets raked over the coals. Meanwhile, Ben's adventure goes awry.

videos.title: Dance Fever (2)
videos.overview: Great expectations turn sour at the Dewey High dance after Mike hears Lydia's voice; and Ben and Stinky find themselves in a seedy diner eyeing a pinball machine that pays real money.

videos.title: Bringing Up Baby
videos.overview: The Seavers begin to make room for baby, relegating Ben to the guest quarters and making the others lament the changes bound to come. Meanwhile, Maggie grasps for a way to tell her boss she is pregnant.

videos.title: The Obscure Objects of Our Desire
videos.overview: Spring-cleaning breathes new life into the family's household objects, and each has a story to tell.

videos.title: How the West Was Won (1)
videos.overview: Mike and Boner learn that Coach Lubbock has been fired, prompting them to organize a protest.

videos.title: How the West Was Won (2)
videos.overview: Jason, Carol, Mike and Boner are arrested in the demonstration over the dismissal of Coach Lubbock.

videos.title: Graduation Day
videos.overview: At Mike's high-school graduation, family members recall moments when it seemed like his graduation would never take place.

videos.title: Fool for Love
videos.overview: Ben gets spooked at the prospect of asking a girl to a Halloween party; Jason becomes a disruptive force at Lamaze class.

videos.title: Birth of a Seaver
videos.overview: Maggie goes into labor on Ben's 12th birthday and Ben confesses to a patient at the hospital that he's already feeling crowded.

videos.overview: Mike has a showdown with Jason over his rights as an 18-year-old college student, and declares his freedom from parental rule.

videos.title: Family Ties (2)
videos.overview: Landlord-tenant problems abound when Mike (Kirk Cameron) moves into the storage area over the family garage

videos.title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner?
videos.overview: Jason sends his mother on a cruise to get her mind off her dead husband, but when she returns with a fiancé in tow, Jason finds it hard to accept the man who will "replace" his father.

videos.title: Ben's First Kiss

videos.title: Mandingo
videos.overview: A travel snafu strands Julie with Mike.

videos.title: In Carol We Trust
videos.overview: Carol sneaks out of the house for a date.

videos.title: Mom of the Year

videos.title: Semper Fidelis

videos.title: Feet of Clay
videos.overview: Maggie arranges for Ben to meet his favorite rock musician.

videos.title: Anniversary from Hell

videos.title: The Recruiter

videos.title: Second Chance

videos.title: Anger With Love

videos.title: The Truck Stops Here
videos.overview: Luke's father George visits the Seavers hoping that Luke has mellowed a little and would like to spend some time with him but Luke doesn't. He was about to leave when he collapses outside the door. He says that can't move, so they take him in. Jason and Ben offer to deliver his load, and they experience all sorts of chaos on the way. Mike thinks that George is faking his injury so that he could stay and Luke would have to talk to him. But the doctor tells Maggie who tells Mike that unless George stops driving trucks, he could become paralyzed. Mike talks to George and tells him to tell Luke but doesn't want Luke to pity him and doesn't anything else to do but be a trucker. Mike suggests that maybe he could open a truck stop. Luke finds George struggling to get up and they finally talk. The next day after Jason and Ben return, George tells them that he is giving up trucking and will open a truck stop and Luke's going with him. Luke says goodbye to the Seavers.

videos.title: The Last Picture Show
videos.overview:
Maggie is offered a plum job in Washington, D.C.

The Seavers move to Washington, D.C., but share a final meal and memories in the empty house.

awards: Won 2 Primetime Emmys. 17 wins & 24 nominations total
